description: 台灣糖業公司橋頭糖廠循環經濟造景綠美化景點 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣糖業股份有限公司. 橋頭糖廠「糖廠鐵件愛情公園」設置有六件裝置藝術作品，這些作品的材料來自橋頭糖廠、旗山糖廠、小港精煉糖廠及岡山垃圾焚化廠閒置的鐵片、鏈條、圓盤、墊片、螺栓、軸承等機械鐵件；糖廠員工發揮美感與創意，將零散的閒置鐵件進行分類、設計、重組與焊接，打造「心心相印－心花盛開」、「相伴」、「福蝶綿綿」、「浪漫馬車」、「共傘」、「花前明月心」六件充滿愛情... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣糖業股份有限公司. Its tags are 休閒旅遊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-08-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
